bullets.text: Full-year CR 88.8 — possibly one of the best years in company history; PL CR 88.6; CL CR 89.4; property CR 98.3, profitable but short of its target margin.
Companywide NPW +21% YOY to $74B, from an 18% PIF increase and higher average written premiums; PL NPW +23%; CL NPW +8%, influenced by the macroeconomic environment.
Added 5M+ PIFs in 2024 (+18% YOY); personal auto PIFs +22% led growth; claims and call-center staff hired well in advance of need to support it.
$4.50/share annual-variable dividend; $500M preferred shares redeemed; debt-to-capital 21.2%, near the low end of its historical range; portfolio returned 4.6% (fixed income 3.8%, equity 22.9%).
Companywide media spend up 150% YOY to drive growth; #2 U.S. personal auto insurer for a third straight year; Superstore and Dr. Rick continued; new NFL 'Back Up' campaign launched.

Companywide 88.8 CR reflected Progressive's ability to reduce operating expenses and increase acquisition expenses to leverage its competitive position; hiring well in advance of need supported profitable growth.

Combined ratio of 88.8 reflected adequate rates that match risks along with favorable reserve development; Progressive notes that its markets are very competitive and price remains a significant consideration.
Gallup Exceptional Workplace for a fourth consecutive year; ERG event attendance rose to 26% of employees from 19%; pay equity maintained; nearly $10M in employee disaster relief.
BOP available in 46 states (~80% of the commercial multi-peril market); HomeQuote Explorer offers online homeowners purchase in 46 states plus DC, with eight partner carriers integrated.
Annual theme of empathy frames the letter; customer and lender accounts illustrate service and claims care, and customer obsession is designated the core focus going forward.
